from pathlib import Path
import collections, hashlib, json, re, shutil, sys
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tool/playback_benchmark'))
from resources import summarize_trials,summarize_disposed_memory,summarize_endurance
from lifetime_windows import validate_window
from memory_categories import parse_vmmap
out=Path('/private/tmp/yl-long-lifetimes-100')
r=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text());probes=json.loads((out/'lifetime-probes.json').read_text())
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows=[json.loads(l.split('YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=',1)[1]) for l in (out/'playback.log').read_text().splitlines() if 'YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=' in l]
assert rows==r['observations']==[json.loads(l) for l in (out/'observations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert summarize_trials(rows)==r['summary']
assert summarize_disposed_memory(rows)==r['disposedMemory']
assert summarize_endurance(rows)==r['endurance']
assert all(digest(root/p)==h for group in ('sourceFingerprints','dependencies','artifactFingerprints') for p,h in r[group].items())
assert digest(out/'protocol.json')==r['protocolSha256']
assert digest(out/'resources.dylib')==r['samplerSha256']
assert digest(root/'packages/yl_player/example/assets/test_media/format_matrix/mkv-avc-aac.mkv')==r['mediaHash']
assert all(digest(out/n)==m['sha256'] and (out/n).stat().st_size==m['bytes'] for n,m in r['logs'].items())
markers={(m['attempt'],m['phase'],m['edge']):m for m in probes['markers']}
core=('YlApplePlayerHost','YlAppleSessionCoordinator','YlManagedPlaybackSession','YlOpenedMedia',
      'YlVideoToolboxDecoder','YlFrameScheduler','YlPresentationCoordinator','YlManagedBufferLedger',
      'YlManagedBufferLedger.Token','YlApplePlayerRegistry')
heaps=[]
for record in probes['records']:
 key=(record['attempt'],record['phase'])
 assert validate_window(markers.get((*key,'begin')),markers.get((*key,'end')),record)==record['qualified']
 if 'raw' not in record:continue
 path=out/record['raw']['file'];text=path.read_text()
 assert digest(path)==record['raw']['sha256'] and path.stat().st_size==record['raw']['bytes']
 if record['tool']=='vmmap' and record['status']=='captured':
  assert parse_vmmap(text,record['pid'])==record['summary']
 if record['tool']!='heap' or record['status']!='captured':continue
 assert len(re.findall(r'^Process: +yl_player_example \['+str(record['pid'])+r'\] *$',text,re.M))==1
 totals=re.findall(r'^All zones: (\d+) nodes \((\d+) bytes\)$',text,re.M);assert len(totals)==1
 classes=[]
 for line in text.splitlines():
  match=re.fullmatch(r'\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+(.+)',line)
  if not match:continue
  parts=re.split(r'\s{2,}',match[4].strip());assert len(parts) in (1,2,3)
  classes.append(dict(count=int(match[1]),bytes=int(match[2]),name=parts[0],
                      type=parts[1] if len(parts)==3 else None,binary=parts[-1] if len(parts)>1 else None))
 nodes,size=map(int,totals[0]);assert sum(x['count'] for x in classes)==nodes and sum(x['bytes'] for x in classes)==size
 selected=[]
 for name in core:
  matches=[x for x in classes if x['name']==name and x['type']=='Swift' and x['binary']=='yl_player_example']
  assert len(matches)<=1
  selected.append(dict(name=name,status='listed' if matches else 'not_listed',count=matches[0]['count'] if matches else None,bytes=matches[0]['bytes'] if matches else None))
 heaps.append(dict(attempt=record['attempt'],phase=record['phase'],qualified=record['qualified'],nodes=nodes,bytes=size,
                   classes=classes,coreTypes=selected,absentMeansZero=False))
raw={}
for path in sorted(out.iterdir()):
 if path.suffix not in ('.txt','.log') and path.name!='protocol.json':continue
 raw[path.name]=dict(sha256=digest(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size,text=path.read_text())
script=Path(__file__)
raw['archive-long-lifetimes.py']=dict(sha256=digest(script),bytes=script.stat().st_size,text=script.read_text())
app=root/'packages/yl_player/example/build/macos/Build/Products/Profile/yl_player_example.app/Contents/MacOS/yl_player_example'
evidence=dict(schemaVersion=1,purpose='long-cycle-lifetime-diagnostics',run=r,probes=probes,
 heapSummaries=heaps,rawFiles=raw,sourceIdentityVerifiedAgain=True,
 appExecutable=dict(path=str(app.relative_to(root)),sha256=digest(app)),
 performanceBaseline=False,budgetAdmission=False,leakVerdict=None,physicalOutput='not_verified',
 limitations=['Diagnostic waits/probes perturb workload; not a numeric performance comparison',
 'Heap class recognition is partial; not_listed is not zero or proof of deallocation',
 'Heap allocated bytes, rounded vmmap categories and physical footprint are different ledgers',
 'Native/C++/Dart/GPU/anonymous allocations and ownership not fully identified',
 'Continuous long film/background/multiplayer/pressure/devices remain separate'])
target=root/'tool/playback_benchmark/macos-long-lifetime-observations.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(evidence,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
shutil.copytree(out,root/'.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-26-remaining-08-performance-release/long-lifetimes-100')
print('Archived',r['runId'],r['runStatus'],'probes complete',probes['complete'],'bytes',target.stat().st_size)
for h in heaps:print(h['attempt'],h['phase'],'nodes',h['nodes'],'bytes',h['bytes'],'core',[(x['name'],x['count']) for x in h['coreTypes']])
